m4_pro_method: One Apple M4 Pro, one greedy text stream, eight English prompts repeated across three fresh processes per configuration, up to 256 output tokens per chat. Thinking and speculation were disabled. Median output rate includes streamed detokenization and the next token or stop decision. Startup and prompt processing were timed separately. All files were on the same drive and were read once immediately before each timed load to warm the filesystem cache. Each startup median covers three starts with dependencies installed.

guarded_subset_kernel_test.method: Synchronized Metal graphs. Twelve alternating paired rounds, four full graph calls per observation. Sum of group medians for one scan. Logical weight payload / elapsed time, no DRAM counter.

weight_accounting: Native allocations, rotations, and for Ternzip embedding tables, row cache and decoder reserve. Full process memory also includes context, scratch and OS file caching.

prompt_texts.short-story: Tell me a short story about a locksmith who finds a note in the keyhole of her own shop.
prompt_texts.explanation: Why does the inside of a parked car get so warm on a sunny but chilly day? Explain it over a cup of coffee.
prompt_texts.letter: Help me write to my old roommate. I found the recipe card he thought he lost, tucked into our battered board game.
prompt_texts.description: Describe the moment a bookmobile arrives at a seaside town just after the ferry lets out.
prompt_texts.advice: A friend and I share a small pottery studio. We both want the sunny table. How can we talk about it without making things awkward?
prompt_texts.opinion: Would a neighborhood be better with a public piano or a long picnic table? Pick one and talk me through it.
prompt_texts.playful: Give me the dog's version of why everyone in the house should get up when the mail comes on Saturday.
prompt_texts.reflection: What do you learn about a familiar place when you take a visiting cousin there for the first time? Give me a personal-sounding answer.
